summary: This tracker blends CS owner judgment with a statistical renewal model to prioritize accounts for Q3 outreach. The goal is to generate a ranked list with suggested next steps and clear owners so AE/CS can act in a targeted way ahead of contract end dates.
model_description: ModelScore is produced by a logistic regression trained on the last 24 months of renewals (features: net ARR change, usage decile, support tickets last 90d, NPS bucket, days since last contact). Blended Prob = round(0.4 * ManualProbability + 0.6 * ModelScore, 0), manual probability uses owner input. Scores normalized between 0 and 1 and expressed as percent in sheet.
notes: Caveats: model underweights newly onboarded accounts (<90 days) and seasonal renewals; manually review large ARR (> $200k) separately. Use this as a prioritization signal, not a single source of truth. Update Manual Probability weekly after syncs.
